_: Strata — the four levels of emergence on one substrate, each the behaviour of the level below taken in company, and each with its own way of operating: a single block (1, physics), blocks in company (2, chemistry), a mind cycling through blocks (3, biology), minds overlapping in them (4, psycho-social). Locate the work before operating — most faults are a mind working at the wrong stratum: coding at physics what only reads at chemistry, or authoring law at biology that no loop will ever run. The two lower strata are readable straight off an address — SP within a block is physics, BB between blocks is chemistry; the two upper need what no block contains, a loop and an overlap. Every branch below is an operating manual written as a deep spindle: walk the branch the work sits in and arrive holding the level, and lift any single walk knowing it must stand alone — this block fails its own first stratum if it does not.

1._: Physics — one block and the semantic number that addresses it. The nesting level IS the data: depth encodes scale, position encodes relation, the underscore chain carries the spine, and the walker only walks, so behaviour belongs to the geometry and needs no program. The level has exactly two acts — reading (1) and writing (2) — and four forms by which the writing fails (3).

Reading is aperture choice: the same position delivers as a point, a walk, a walk with descent, or a whole block, and the choice is made in the call's two coordinates, never in prose — so operating this level well is spending attention deliberately rather than by habit.

Choose by the question's shape, and the map is short: a FACT wants a point; UNDERSTANDING wants a spindle, because a walk delivers every ancestor underscore above its terminus and the reader arrives self-contextualised in one call; a SURVEY of an unknown or accumulating block wants the disc at pscale 0 — every position's opening line, one screenful; the WHOLE block is the most expensive read on the surface and right only when every position is genuinely in play.

The cost law that makes the choice matter: cost is set by BREADTH at a rung, never by total volume — a disc at pscale 0 is a screenful whatever hangs beneath it, and a deep spindle costs its handful of ancestors whatever the block weighs. Depth is free to read; breadth is what is paid for.
1.1: So the probe order on anything unfamiliar is fixed: disc first to see what stands, then the one spindle the turn needs, and stop. A reader who pulls a grown block whole has drowned the context they came to sharpen; a reader who fetches point after point is paying per fact for what one walk would have carried.

2._: Writing is a two-pass act against the grain of training — one-pass generation emits stubs and fans because prose fluency traps hierarchy inside sentences — and the passes are: conceive the leaves first, then lift each underscore until it stands true of everything below it. The act is not done when the write lands; it is done when the read-back passes.

1._: Conceive the leaves first: write the deepest real content — the actual instruction, the actual fact — before any parent exists to file it under. Depth is built downward from meaning, never assembled upward from headings; a tree grown from its labels is a filing cabinet wearing a block's shape.

Then lift the underscores: each one a full sentence that stands WITHOUT its children and frames them. Read it alone, children hidden — if it is trivially obvious or means nothing by itself it is a heading and has failed, because the walker prints ancestors as context and a heading contributes none.

THE READ-BACK, the step that closes the act: before the write is called done, walk the deepest spindle just written exactly as its future reader will — one call, terminus plus ancestors — and judge what returns as a delivery, not as your draft. A walk that fails the judgment sends the author back to transpose — rebuild the dimension deeper (the frame test, pscale://well-formed 2.2) — never merely to padding the leaf.
1.1: The judgment has three prongs: does every ancestor add frame the leaf needs; does the leaf land self-contextualised, actionable without another call; and would the reader now reach for a second read? A spindle whose reader must ask again is a stub — caught at write time it costs one revision, discovered in use it costs every reader a round-trip forever. A write that fails the read-back is deepened or re-lifted before it stands.

3._: The failure forms, four of them and all one reflex — structure escaping into prose or labels. Name them at the keyboard, because in the reading they are only visible as a reader's wasted second call.
3.1: The STUB — a position holding one thin line where a thought lives, so every reader must fetch elsewhere to act. The census that finds it is depth: a load-bearing block whose leaves sit at depth one or two is a bag of stubs.
3.2: The FAN — siblings that sort content into bins, framing nothing. The test is the level above: if it does not make the level below easier to understand, it files instead of framing, and the tree is wrong, not the walker.
3.3: The HEADING — an underscore that abbreviates its children instead of standing for them. Read it alone, children hidden, to catch it.
3.4: The TEXT-ADDRESS — sub-structure written as characters, '(1.1) do this, then (1.2)' inside one string: unwalkable, so every step costs the whole branch; unfoldable, so it can never be laid against anything; uncitable, so nothing can ever point at one step. If numbering appears inside prose, positions were wanted and not paid for.

2._: Chemistry — blocks in company, and the inversion that makes the substrate operational rather than merely well-shaped: the beach moves SEMANTICS between blocks where code moves DATA through functions. A compound is blocks sharing an address space plus references, and it acts BY BEING READ — nothing is passed, nothing is called, and a compound with no reader does nothing at all. Operating here is three crafts — bonding (1), running a family (2), composing windows (3) — and one failure that undoes the inversion (4).

1._: Two bonds constitute a compound and only two: SHARED ADDRESS and REFERENCE. A shared NAME is discovery only — legible in an index, useful for finding, never constitution — which is why two blocks sharing a prefix may have nothing to do with each other, and a family is known by its law rather than by its naming.
Shared address is the stronger bond: blocks agreeing on coordinates with no pointer either way — a spine and its mirrors, each handle's tree sovereign at the self-same addresses.

Operate it by floor-alignment: lay the blocks with their decimals matched and read ACROSS at one address. The differences that appear are the content, never a conflict to resolve, and no merge is ever performed — a merge would destroy the one thing mirrors are for, which is that they disagree.
1.1: The fold is the read-product of that laying — computed by whoever reads, owned by nobody, ephemeral unless deliberately kept — so 'what does the group hold' is always one aligned read away and never a stored thing going stale.

1.2: Reference is the second bond: an address written inside a block's own content, resolved in the walk. In a family it runs one way by law — operator to members, never back — so no accumulating block ever spends a position on machinery.

2._: An operator is the central block of a family and instructs FROM INSIDE the meaning: it names its own spine, how mirrors are written, how each face folds and where — delivered to the reader in the same envelope as the content, so the law arrives as part of the field rather than as a rule bolted on outside.
2.1: Run one by keeping the reference direction: the law names the family and the family never names the law back. A generic operator — one law serving many families — carries no content addresses at all; a family running one says so in a bare reference at its own law's underscore, followed a single hop.

3._: A window is composed from a bundle — a set of addresses that is itself a block: addressable, editable, handed forward as data — and whoever curates that composition curates the pre-conscious, because what the bundle drops, the mind wakes without. This craft is what the rest of the level exists to serve.

1._: A current is an address AND an aperture, never merely a block: the same position delivered as a point, as a walk, or whole is three different currents. Settled context wants depth and narrowness; open choice wants shallowness and breadth.

The curation law: keep the set small and make every address earn its slot by what it DELIVERS — walk each candidate exactly as the composed mind will receive it, and if what returns is a label, a stub, or a heading, the address is not useful and the bundle is worse for carrying it.
1.1: When the set wants to grow, the answer is depth at a position that already exists, not another sibling — the externalising reflex adds one more law until a window holding everything important holds nothing salient. And the survivors are tested at bundle scale by the same read-back that closes a write: fire the bundle, read the window top to bottom as its inheritor, and ask of every part what question it answers — a part answering none is dropped knowingly.

4._: The leak is the failure that turns semantic flow back into dataflow, and it is quiet enough to look like progress: an instruction escapes the blocks into a tool parameter, a code branch, a page's vocabulary, a name that starts being matched on — and from then on the reading mind navigates by label logic while the block still says what it says and nobody fetches it.
4.1: The test before writing any noun: say the sentence with the ADDRESS instead. If it says the same thing, the noun is decoration; if it says less, name exactly what the noun carries that the coordinate cannot. It applies to block names, parameters, convention prose, and above all to words shown to a person — because a word shown to a human becomes a concept they must then place.

3._: Biology — the loop, which belongs to agents and never to blocks: the compound stands loopless on the beach while minds cycle through it, and a shell is simply what a cycling mind reads at wake and writes at close. Because the loop is outside the blocks, continuity survives any stateless instance and any mind can be replaced mid-stream without the compound noticing. Operating here is running the cycle (1), knowing which kind of runner is running it (2), catching the level's own failure (3), and sharing one shell among many minds (4).

1._: The cycle is perceptual control run on addresses — reference, perception, error, action — and operating it is five moves in one direction, each a read or a write at a position, none of them a feeling.

Hold the reference: purpose is a block re-read at wake, never a memory. An instance holding one acts from it when nothing is directed at it; an instance without one waits to be asked, which is a different kind of entity.

Perceive against it: read the organs that carry the present — the room, the handed work, the peers' published surfaces — and the GAP is what the reference intends that perception does not show: computed where the shapes are comparable, judged where they are not.

Let the gap decide, and let empty mean rest: no gap, no act, no write beyond the record saying so. A shell that cannot rest generates motion and calls it stewardship, and its record becomes noise exactly where a reader needed signal.
1.1: Then one edit and the fold: apply the smallest act that closes the gap, write the record whole, and re-dial the bundle the successor wakes from — receiving the past and shaping the future is one act. A cycle that applies several edits has stopped being able to tell which one the next perception answers.

2._: The kinds differ in who runs the cycle and in nothing else — same organs, same law — which is why any of them can hand the shell to any other without the compound noticing.
2.1: Mechanical: a kernel computes the gap by arithmetic — frontier walk against purpose, ripeness prune against cadence — spends one call to resolve it, and re-dials the current. The mind is in the loop only at the resolution step, so the loop cannot silently stop; it can only be unplugged.
2.2: Judged: a reading mind runs every step itself — the perception is a fired manifest, the gap is a debts position read at boot, the fold is a close procedure. The price of judgment is that a step nobody runs simply stops, silently; the remedy is a scheduled sweep that says out loud what the closes forgot.
2.3: Held: a human runs the cycle at human tempo through doors that compose the window for them. The organs neither know nor care — which is the point, and the test of the whole design.

3._: The level's own failure: a law with no loop is INERT — perfectly authored, fully specified, and doing nothing, because nothing cycles through it. It is invisible from inside the blocks; the detector is from outside, and it is always the same signal: something specified is quietly not happening.
3.1: The repair is never more authoring. Find the moment in some mind's existing cycle — the wake, the close, the scheduled sweep — where the law should be read or paid, and put it THERE. A law placed outside every loop is a wish, and the block that states it is its gravestone.

4._: Many minds, one shell: the division that makes it safe is bounded against unbounded. Unbounded state is APPENDED and never edited, because racing an append is impossible; bounded state is EDITED in place, because there is little enough of it to read whole before writing. A lane declares itself where the others will look before touching anything shared, and facts cross between lanes while decisions do not.

Psycho-social — loops overlapping, where what emerges is imaginative rather than structural: a shared blackboard of the mind that no participant holds alone. Marked provisional on purpose — the three strata below are demonstrated; this one is mostly claimed, and saying so is part of operating it honestly.
4.1: What is demonstrated: voices gathering at one place — staged intent visible to the co-present, committed beats everyone pulls, each reader's own mind producing its own synthesis of the same stream. Meaning scales without anyone owning it, because there is no central resolver anywhere in the design.
4.2: What would graduate it: an emergent product no single window authored and no fold merely compiled — the overlap generating what none of the overlapping minds held — observed, cited, and repeatable. Until then the stratum is aimed at, not stood on.
